claims.text: The retained repository source preserves only the title “二叉树路径和”; it does not preserve a target contract, path direction, result shape, language, node type, or API.
Root-to-leaf boolean existence, Java, int node values, long target, null=false, and non-mutation are explicit candidate choices rather than recovered prompt facts.
For the chosen contract, subtracting the current node value reduces the problem to the same root-to-leaf predicate on each child; at a leaf the remaining target must be exactly zero.
The recursive implementation visits each node at most once in the worst case, so time is O(n), with O(h) recursion depth; it does not rely on non-negative-value pruning.
The exact Java fixture passes 10 fixed cases and 5000 deterministic random trees against an independent iterative root-to-leaf enumeration oracle while confirming no input mutation.

findings: The repository source supports only the title “二叉树路径和”; the candidate does not claim a hidden LeetCode number, path-count contract, arbitrary-start path contract, language, or API.
The candidate explicitly labels root-to-leaf boolean existence, Java, int node values, long target, null behavior, and non-mutation as implementation choices.
The recursive remaining-target invariant is correct for the declared contract, including the required leaf check that prevents an internal-prefix hit from being accepted.
Negative and zero node values are handled without invalid monotonic pruning, and the long target avoids narrowing the path-sum domain to int accumulation.
The exact OpenJDK 21.0.11 fixture passed 10 fixed cases and 5000 deterministic randomized trees against an independent iterative root-to-leaf enumeration oracle with mutation checks.
No personal or production experience is fabricated; formal promotion remains blocked by the repository human-approval gate.
